response.sql:
WITH record_shares AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    traitcount,
    traitcount::numeric / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    traitcount,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin
  FROM record_shares
)
SELECT
  zoneref,
  traitcount,
  share,
  margin
FROM ranked
WHERE margin > 0
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Treat each non-NULL traitcount as a record's feature count, and calculate its share as a fraction of the sum of those counts; the average share is the arithmetic mean across those same records.
